name: U.S. city average CPI-U, all items, not seasonally adjusted
note: Calendar-year CPI is an approximate comparison with city fiscal-year spending. The 2025 published average excludes October, when CPI collection was unavailable. BLS has monthly observations through October 2026, but no full-year 2026 average or 2027 observations as of November 22, 2026. The 2026–2027 annual values are projections using the 2015–2025 compound annual growth rate (3.11% per year); monthly 2026 readings are not substituted for a full-year average. This is a historical-rate scenario, not an official forecast. CPI measures consumer prices, not the specific costs of city services; this benchmark does not adjust for population, staffing, service changes or one-time projects.

projection.method: Compound annual growth rate over ten years: (2025 annual CPI / 2015 annual CPI)^(1/10) - 1. Extend the 2025 annual index by that rate for each projected year. This is a historical-rate scenario, not an official forecast.
